text:
December 4, 1970
FHWA concurs that the Airport Spur did not require the use of publicly owned lands (Section 4(f) lands).
January 1, 1971
A-95 Clearinghouse approval (SEWRPC) that Airport Spur is in conformance with regional transportation plan and Milwaukee County Jurisdictional Highway System Plan.
February 22, 1971
FHWA re-evaluates the Airport Spur project and rules that an Environmental Impact Statement would not be required. FHWA re-affirmed position on October 4, 1972.
July 1971
FHWA reviewing design plans for several segments of Airport Spur.
August 23, 1971
Update of Relocation Program Plan submitted by Division of Highways.
March 24, 1972
Update of Relocation Program Plan.
April 14, 1972
Department of Local Affairs and Development approved Relocation Program Plan as submitted by Division of Highways.
April 28, 1972
Enactment of Wisconsin State Environmental Policy Act. (WEPA)
October 11, 1972
Wisconsin Highway Commission directed staff to prepare and circulate Draft Environmental Impact Statement according to WEPA guidelines.
January 24, 1973
FHWA approved ramp connection from the Airport Spur to Howell Avenue.
March 12, 1973
Wisconsin Highway Commission suspended all right of way acquisition activity until Final Environmental Impact Statement is completed and approved.
May 2, 1973
City of Milwaukee Common Council resolution, declaring support for the elimination of the Airport Spur from Milwaukee County Expressway System.
October 23, 1973
City of Milwaukee Common Council modified earlier resolution for opposing the construction of the Airport Spur until demonstrated that it can handle future truck traffic and will not be environmentally detrimental to the area.
